decided_by: Owner (Sequoia), 2026-10-09: fund real research for the safety-net access axis and build it now.
supersedes: The 2026-08-27 record (status latent_deliberately_unresearched). Its evidence and refusals still stand; what changed is that the access build it described as the only acceptable route has now been done.
one_line: Every researched dentistry metro now answers the two open safety-net queries - free and low-cost dental clinics, and dental school clinics - from sourced entries, and is indexed through the existing research-file switch. Every other dentistry city page stays templated and noindex, deliberately. All counts are in 'measurements', written by scripts/research/measure_dentistry_vertical_status.js and checked on every build, so this record cannot rot into an accident.
measurements_note: The block below is generated. Do not edit it by hand: scripts/validation/dentistry_safety_net_research_contract.js (hard_fail tier) re-measures and fails the build if it differs. Re-run with --write after any change to the dentistry research files or page set.

what_is_actually_true_today.pages: measurements.city_pages_built city pages are built (the dentistry page set, plus the base top-10 in data/cities.json, plus promoted rows). measurements.research_backed_pages_built of them have a research file and are index,follow; measurements.cities_rendering_the_template render the slug template and are noindex,nofollow.
what_changed_on_2026-10-09: houston-tx and miami-fl had research files but no page (they existed only for the phase4.5 priority-set contract). They were added to data/page_sets/examples/cities_dentistry_v1.json, so all six researched metros now have a page. Nothing was removed.

Each of the six research files gained a safety_net_access block: free_low_cost and dental_school entries, each with name, address/phone, official URL, eligibility, services, how to get seen, cost language without figures, source_url and fetched_on. Counts per metro are in measurements.safety_net_entries_per_metro.

build_city_sites.js renders the block as two answer sections with anchors #free-low-cost-dental-clinics and #dental-school-clinics, headed 'Free & low-cost dental clinics in <metro>' and 'Dental school clinics in <metro>', at the top of the city page.

Repair found in passing: normalizeLegacyCityContent() dropped every per-vertical section key (dentistry insurance/sedation/triage/pediatric notes, uscis I-693 and vaccination notes, trt, neuro, pi), so those sections never rendered on research-backed pages. It now carries them through.
what_is_actually_true_today.robots: Unchanged mechanism, no special case. build_city_sites.js stamps data-template-fallback="true" when a city has no research file; scripts/apply_robots_policy.js noindexes on that stamp; scripts/sitemap_emit.js drops noindex pages. The six researched metros carry no stamp, so they are index,follow and in the sitemap; the rest are not.
what_is_actually_true_today.business_model: Researched pages carry the same /for-providers/ link ($249/month featured listing, first two months free) and the same /request-assistance/ lead form and next-steps hub as the uscisexam metros - both come from the shared city template, verified on the built pages. Dentists are the paying side; patients searching the safety-net queries are the traffic.
what_is_actually_true_today.promotion: Still zero dentistry cities promoted (measurements.cities_promoted). Indexing a researched page does not need promotion, and promotion is still not a CSV edit (see two_things_a_later_reader_should_know_before_acting).

the_decision: Build the safety-net access axis per metro from primary sources, index only the metros where that research exists, and keep every other dentistry city page published-but-noindexed. Extend to a further metro only by writing its research file to the same standard; the contract refuses a researched page with fewer than three sourced entries in either section.

safety_net_access_axis_is_OPEN.result: 'free dental clinic near me' and 'dental school clinic near me' show zero national-brand slots and a high unbranded share (values in measurements.open_axis_probes). Same structural shape as 'civil surgeon near me': an access question whose answer is a list nobody authoritative publishes.
safety_net_access_axis_is_OPEN.why_it_is_researchable: Its answer is a published list, not a price. Every entry is read from the clinic's own page or a state directory (Texas DSHS for Texas dental hygiene clinics).

cost_axis_is_closed.verdict: CLOSED. Confirmed, and not disturbed by the 2026-08-27 round.
why: The ADA discontinued its Survey of Dental Fees in 2023 and is barred by federal law from quoting or recommending fees, so no authoritative US dental price list exists. See data/research/costs/sources.json -> ada_hpi_dental_care_market and its not_available entry.

Medicare largely excludes routine and restorative dentistry, so the CDT codes for crowns, bridges and standard implants are absent from the CMS files that make neuro and trt researchable per city. State coverage on the dental codes runs from 13 states down to none.
scripts/validation/demand_backed_pages.js records the same conclusion independently: dentistry is 'not a gap, it is an absence'.

Consequence: any per-city dental price on these pages would be invented. sourced_cost_figures_contract.js requires every dollar figure to be traceable, and the correct number of new dollar figures here is zero.

provider_directory_axis_is_closed.measurement: data/signals/dentistry_query_class_openness_2026-08-27.json -> probes['dentist that accepts medicaid near me']
provider_directory_axis_is_closed.result: 0.00 unbranded share, 0.50 national brand share. Yelp holds two slots; Delta Dental, UnitedHealthcare and Zocdoc hold one each. This is the axis the current pack is written against, and it is genuinely defended.

hard_rules: No dollar figures on the access axis. Where a clinic publishes a fee, the entry points to the source page instead of copying the figure. measurements.dollar_figures_in_dentistry_city_content is the count, and the contract fails on any $ figure that is not inside a sourced entry.
No invented clinics, hours or prices. An entry without a source_url and fetched_on date fails the build.
Do not retire the dentistry pack or any page in it. Noindexed-and-latent remains the resting state for unresearched cities.
Do not index a dentistry city by any route other than writing its research file to this standard.

guards.dentistry_safety_net_research_contract: scripts/validation/dentistry_safety_net_research_contract.js, hard_fail tier in data/contracts/validator_tiering_policy.json. Pins: at least 3 sourced entries per section on every researched (indexed) page; every entry has a source URL and fetch date; no $ figure without a source; no research file without a page; these measurements current; and, in the dentistry pack build, rendered pages index,follow with both sections and every entry's source line, templated pages noindex.
guards.promoted_city_research_contract: scripts/validation/promoted_city_research_contract.js, unchanged: no promoted city without a research file.

negative_test.method: Four breaks, one at a time, each restored before the next: (1) cut chicago-il dental_school below the minimum; (2) blank one chicago-il entry's source_url; (3) add a '$99' sentence to chicago-il payment_options, an unsourced field; (4) in the built dentistry dist, flip miami-fl to noindex and remove its #dental-school-clinics anchor, then run the contract with LKG_VALIDATE_DIST=1 and the dentistry PAGE_SET_FILE.
negative_test.result: Every break exited 1 and named the file and the entry or page: 'dental_school has 2 entries; an indexed page needs at least 3', 'source_url missing or not https', 'dollar figure outside a sourced entry', and for (4) both 'researched page is not index,follow' and 'missing #dental-school-clinics section'. The restored tree passed each time.

two_things_a_later_reader_should_know_be.promoting_dentistry_is_not_a_csv_edit: It cannot be done by adding rows. scripts/validation/coverage_plan_contract.js hard-codes VALID_VERTICALS to neuro, trt and uscis-medical, and report_coverage_status.js carries the same list. A dentistry row fails immediately. Promotion would therefore require editing a validator - which is exactly the kind of change that should never be made to get a coverage number to move. Beyond that it needs a runtime-support row per city with a listings file (38 of the 53 pack cities have none) and every provider name from the example-provider dataset rendered on the page. Promotion is a project, not a flag.
two_things_a_later_reader_should_know_be.the_cost_guard_does_not_cover_these_file: scripts/validation/sourced_cost_figures_contract.js still reads doc.main_html only, so it passes over every data/city_content file. For dentistry that gap is now closed by dentistry_safety_net_research_contract.js (no $ figure outside a sourced entry). For neuro, trt and uscis_medical it remains open; widening it is a cross-vertical change and does not belong to this record.

standing_constraints: Do not retire the dentistry pack or any page in it. The owner's standing rule is that nothing in this portfolio gets killed; noindexed-and-latent is the intended resting state, not a step toward deletion.
Do not promote a dentistry city to make a coverage number move. The contract will stop it, and the contract is right.
Do not fill the templated city pages with figures to make them look researched. There are no dental price figures to fill them with.
revisit_this_decision_if: A further metro is to be indexed: write its research file to this standard; nothing else is needed.
The safety-net probes are re-measured and the class closes (national brands take the slots).
A per-city dental cost dataset with a citable publisher appears - the cost axis stays closed until then.
